# Archive

Frozen course deliverables, kept for provenance.

Nothing here is maintained alongside the code, and nothing here should be treated
as a current description of the system — the reports describe the project as it
stood when each was submitted. For how it works today, start at
[../README.md](../README.md).

**Do not edit these files.** If something in them is wrong or out of date, that is
expected; fix the living documentation instead.

| File | What it is |
| :--- | :--- |
| `ER_Digram.png` / `ER_Digram.drawio` | The original ER diagram, and its editable draw.io source |
| `report-1.md`, `report-2.md`, `report-3.md` | Staged progress reports |
| `final-report.md`, `final-report-v2.pdf`, `report.html` | Final submissions |
| `deep-research-report.md` | Background research written during planning |
| `images/` | Screenshots referenced by the reports above |
